appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line connects eleven black circular markers, descending continuously from the upper-left to the lower-right.
The first marker is the highest point on the page, positioned vertically between the '20' and '24.0°C' labels.
The final marker is the lowest point on the page, positioned vertically just above the '10' tick mark.
The line spans a significant vertical distance, dropping from near the top of the chart area to the lower third.
The line covers the full width of the x-axis, from the '2005' tick to the '2015' tick.
The line shows a steady downward trend across all years, with no upward segments.
Each marker has a text label above it indicating a temperature value in °C.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Demand index' and ranges from 0 to 20 with tick marks at 5, 10, 15, and 20.

printed_facts.fact: Years labeled: 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 (2011 is missing from labels but a point exists between 2010 and 2012)
